string.text: First Soviet military self-loading pistol, developed in 1930 by Soviet weapons designer F. Tokarev. Excellently proved itself during World War 2. Even though obsolete by today's standards, due to its ease of maintenance, imposing appearance, powerful cartridge, and a large number of guns found in the warehouses, is unfailingly popular among certain groups of stalkers. Particularly often can be seen in the hands of bandits.
